summary: Iteration 32 — Phase 1 interactivity (swipe-to-reroll, reaction voting, rare-fate scratch reveal, theme foils, coupon scratch). Backend reactions endpoints: 7/7 pytest passing (fresh IDs, IP dedupe, 422 validation, GET/POST correctness). Frontend: reveal card, reaction bar, swipe-to-reroll (3→2→1→hidden with actual card changes), rare-fate scratch reveal, theme-colored foils (summer teal & fantasy gold verified via canvas pixel sampling), post-scratch reveal, shuffle-again, favorites toggle — all working. Local sponsored coupon (CouponReveal sealed) did not surface organically (no local sponsor with coupon.code in surfaced results); skipped per instructions.
action_items: TESTID NAMING MISMATCH (informational only): review_request referenced [data-testid='deal-button']; actual testid in Home.jsx line 1223 is 'spin-roulette-button'. Not a bug — tests updated to use the real id. Suggest documenting canonical testids for future test agents.

Local sponsored card surfaced (Corner Deli & Co with sponsored ribbon) but no CouponReveal (sealed) rendered — the local sponsor has no coupon.code populated. If E1 wants to guarantee the coupon-scratch flow renders on organic deals near ZIP 10001, seed a local sponsor with coupon fields; otherwise this feature stays untested in preview. Rendered chain 'Bonus offer nearby' (ChainCouponStrip) was present on all reveals as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is 1857 lines — should be split into smaller modules (rare-fate logic, shuffle path, filters, deal button) to stay under the 700-line guideline.

shouldRareFate() calls Math.random inside a localStorage-persisted counter — good; but the fallback 'Math.random() < 1/15' path can never trigger extra rare fates if localStorage throws inside the try (return path). Minor edge case only.
ReactionBar optimistic bump is not rolled back if the POST fails with a non-dedupe error — user sees a phantom vote. Consider surfacing at least a subtle indicator or refetching on error.
RevealStage.jsx has grown past 360 lines with multiple concerns (reveal card, alternates, merch CTA, sponsor CTA) — candidate for extraction.

ScratchCover hardcodes threshold cell size (16) and radius default (22) — acceptable, but the theme lookup silently falls back to 'light' foil when an unknown theme is passed, which the report_request intentionally probes (fantasy→gold ✓, summer→teal ✓).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (shake-to-shuffle skipped per scope; coupon-sealed skipped — no local sponsor with coupon.code surfaced)

seed_data_creation: None; test uses fresh uuid-derived place_ids (TEST_rxn_*) to avoid IP-dedupe collisions with the pod IP.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PointerEvents (dispatched via page.evaluate) are required to test framer-motion drag — playwright's page.mouse.down/move/up alone does NOT trigger framer's drag detection on the reveal-photo-header. Same PointerEvent pattern works for ScratchCover canvas. Deal button testid is 'spin-roulette-button' (not 'deal-button'). Rare-fate storage (ff_deal_taps=14, ff_rare_at=15) must be set AFTER page load AND after Skip-intro but BEFORE clicking spin. Theme change (ff_theme='fantasy') requires a page reload to take effect.
